claim: The literal raw-edge threshold universe contains 69 training-eligible and 15 heldout-eligible hierarchy leaves.
evidence_basis: direct computation from supplied OhmNet files

claim: The primary hierarchy-aware algorithm exactly evaluated all 1,062 feasible leaf heldout quartets.
Conditional on the same heldout quartet and hard constraints, hierarchy optimization lowers mean Wu-Palmer similarity for every quartet.
The corresponding reduction in node overlap is typical but not universal.
evidence_basis: paired comparison; lower row overlap for 69.6% of quartets before and 66.8% after tight size matching

claim: Hierarchy separation alone does not guarantee biological-entity separation.
evidence_basis: broad-coverage hierarchy optimum has low WUP but 98.95% row overlap and lookup F1 0.99548

claim: The primary leaf optimum is unchanged when optimizing Wu-Palmer similarity, mean path distance, or minimum path distance.
Lookup F1 outside the original 4,301-gene universe uses the recovered global GO transformation for 209 additional OhmNet genes.
After matching training node and edge totals closely, hierarchy-aware selection still lowers row overlap and lookup F1 on average, but not for every heldout quartet.
evidence_basis: K=25 nearest-size conditional comparison across all 1,062 feasible leaf heldout quartets

claim: The deposited split is not in the literal current-release threshold-defined universe.
evidence_basis: raw edge-record counts for astrocyte, basophil, and midbrain versus the manuscript thresholds
confidence: high for current release; historical cause unresolved
